proposal: Finite reviewed workflow path+exact blob+job-name registry, including reviewed PR-inapplicability proof and passing same-run source guard when one is defined. Unknown workflow changes, ambiguous identity, manual-run events, pending/failing/cancelled checks must continue to block.

Batch exact-head Actions run lookup and bounded workflow metadata catalog; retain every suite→unique run→exact attempt→job/check URL join. Check candidate directory against registry blob identities using one bounded trusted-URL read.

Two complete canonical sweeps,64 requests per sweep,120s sweep and30s per request remain unchanged. Additional pagination consumes remaining budget and must fail closed at64. Observed current counts fit11/54/56; this is design arithmetic, not execution of a modified collector.

Trigger/source-gate separation is conceptually clean for Pages alone but would change dozens of frozen native workflow owners and require regenerated/reviewed declarations; this makes it a larger compatibility change for the full cohort.
